assets.name: SectionEnergyFrame
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Extract and reconstruct ONLY the decorative outer frame and top ornamental stations from the reference UI section, as ONE production transparent PNG asset for SwiftUI. Match the existing shapes/materials faithfully: orange domed energy station with white fork-and-spoon medallion at upper LEFT, little orange-and-blue rover and shrubs upper RIGHT. Theme #FF8D28. Portrait canvas3:4, target1170x1560. Layout for a stretchable UI frame: top decorations confined to top240px, quiet blank colored ribbon from y210 to300px across width, outer frame straight vertical sides continuing from y270px down to bottom, rounded bottom corners. Thin layered glossy toy-like border ~12px thick, corner radius48px. Keep24px transparent margin around the entire outside silhouette. Frame and ornaments opaque, large INNER REGION entirely transparent alpha, no tinted panel fill. Top ribbon must be blank and calm, free of all text/numbers and UI; title will be native overlaid in app. CENTER55% of upper decorative area free from objects. Both top and bottom corners intact. Side rails and bottom contain ONLY the plain theme colored border, no stars or extra motifs, so they can be stretched safely. REMOVE EVERY task card, icon, point star, task illustration, text, count pill, number, button, time, approval stamp. Remove original page background entirely. Genuine transparent alpha both inside and outside frame, not a white/gray rectangle, not a checkerboard. No text, logo, watermark, phone, screenshot or new objects. A single empty ornamental border asset, not a redesign of the page.
